basic_info.description: This expansive residence offers nearly 1,000 sq ft of sophisticated living space, meticulously renovated with over $140K in custom upgrades. Located in the vibrant Yerba Buena Cultural District, this modern masterpiece features sleek, clean lines and high-end finishes, including Slat Wood Panel Walls, top-of-the-line hardwood floors, and Lutron dimmers. The open-concept living and dining area is bathed in natural light and seamlessly connects to a private 300 sq ft outdoor patio that spans the entire length of the home, accessible from both the living room and bedroomideal for outdoor entertaining or a garden. The chef's kitchen boasts Caesarstone countertops, custom cabinetry, and premium appliances. The oversized bedroom offers a serene retreat with an expansive wall of windows and a dedicated home office. The spa-inspired bath showcases wood accents, a rainfall shower, LED mirror, and designer tile. Additional amenities include an in-unit washer/dryer, ample closet space, and leased parking options. This turnkey residence offers the option to purchase designer furnishings for a seamless move-in. Enjoy resort-style living with 24-hour concierge, a heated lap pool by Crunch, and an inviting courtyard, just steps from world-class dining, shopping, cultural venues, and transit.
